verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own feature page lists workflow automation as a first-class feature: users can "create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information," and the vendor also mentions workflow Blueprints. Separately, a Bank Rules API lets users create, update and reorder rules with match filters that act on imported transactions, so the core of event-driven rules is delivered. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the supported trigger events and action types (e.g., webhooks or custom functions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the workflows run as described.
